samples.question: In this picture a network of links joins circular nodes. Precisely three links are tinted: red, green, and blue, while every other link is black. A link is part of a closed loop when, if you mentally cut only that link, its two ends still join up through the rest of the net (it is not a bridge). Exactly one of the three tinted links is part of a closed loop. Which tinted link (red, green, or blue) is the one lying on a loop? Reply with exactly red, green, or blue.
